details.title: Rooftop Tape Night
details.description: A public listening session where guests suggest tracks and vote the queue up in real time.

steps.title: Start with the basics
steps.description: Give people enough context to understand what kind of listening session this is.

steps.title: Who can find it?
steps.description: Choose how this event appears to other people. You can still invite friends directly.

steps.title: Set voting rules
steps.description: Control who can vote. These checks happen before a vote is accepted.

steps.title: Where and when?
steps.description: Finish the event by defining the permitted place and time window.

visibilityOptions.title: Private
visibilityOptions.description: Only invited people can open it.

votingRuleOptions.title: Everyone
votingRuleOptions.description: Anyone in the event can vote.

votingRuleOptions.title: Place + time
votingRuleOptions.description: Voting opens only at the event place and time.

invite.title: Invite required
invite.description: You need an invitation from the event owner before you can vote.

location.title: Outside permitted location
location.description: Move inside the allowed event area to unlock voting.

time.title: Outside permitted time
time.description: Voting is only available during the event's configured time window.

permission.title: Location permission denied
permission.description: Allow location access so Music Room can verify that you are at the event.

not-found.title: Private event not found
not-found.description: This event may be private, removed, or unavailable to your account.
